summary: Adversarial round 1 of Phase 1 (primary_class_session_lifetime_20261111) at audited HEAD 2d05e9e9bc74c1fbc1d52b59f5ca54aa42b494a9 finds no Blocker and no Major. Three new test files (150 cases) attack the enum bypass at the contract, the handler, and the domain; the time boundaries with a fixed clock; the refusal order; the tenant scope of the session; and the value that the panel posts. Every case passes at 2d05e9e9b, so the track keeps no red test. Two Nits go to the close-out record: F201 (a double click in one React batch sends two start requests with the same value) and F202 (the panel posts until_17 after 17:00 Bangkok when no render happens between the clock change and the click; the server refuses the value). The three new files are committed in e5b97e84c.
nonblocking_findings: F201 [Nit] adversarial-testing: two clicks that land in one React batch send two start requests; the probe counts 1 request for two fireEvent clicks and 2 requests for two clicks dispatched in one act, and both bodies hold the same lifetime. Rationale: the server restarts the class, so the second request replaces the first session with the same choice; the panel disables the button after the first click, and no value outside the choice list ever reaches the server. Default: no change; the orchestrator decides whether the panel guards the start with a ref.

F202 [Nit] adversarial-testing: the panel posts until_17 after 17:00 Bangkok when the clock passes 17:00 and no render happens before the click; the server then answers 400 with the code invalid_input and the teacher sees the lifetime error. Rationale: the server stays the authority and refuses the value, so no longer session opens; the panel polls every 10 s (ROSTER_POLL_MS = 10000), so the window is short. Default: no change; this extends the Review A finding F171.

New domain file packages/domain/src/__tests__/student-login-lifetime.adversarial.test.ts: 94 tests, exit 0. It holds 30 enum-bypass rows at the contract and at the domain ('7D', '7d ', ' 7d', 'until_17 ', 'UNTIL_17', '168h', '30d', '1d', '3H', '', 604800000, 10800000, 7, 0, -1, true, false, null, NaN, Infinity, ['7d'], [], { value: '7d' }, {}, 'constructor', 'toString', 'valueOf', 'hasOwnProperty', '__proto__', 'prototype'). Each row throws the code invalid_input and writes no row.

Time boundaries in the domain file: the literal table covers 2026-11-11T09:59:59.999Z (works, expiry 2026-11-11T10:00:00.000Z), 09:59:59.000Z (works), 10:00:00.000Z (refused), 16:59:59.999Z (refused, 23:59:59.999 Bangkok), 2026-11-10T16:59:59.999Z (refused, the Bangkok date of the day before), 2026-11-11T17:00:00.000Z (works, expiry 2026-11-12T10:00:00.000Z, the Bangkok date changes), and 2026-11-10T17:00:00.000Z (works, expiry 2026-11-11T10:00:00.000Z). Every allowed expiry sits at 10:00:00.000 UTC, which is 17:00 Asia/Bangkok.

Exact spans in the domain file: '7d' gives 604800000 ms at 2026-11-11T05:00:00.000Z, 2026-03-07T12:00:00.000Z, and 2026-11-01T12:00:00.000Z (the weeks of the daylight saving change in America/Los_Angeles); '3h' and a missing lifetime give 10800000 ms; every accepted lifetime keeps 0 < expiry - now <= 604800000.

Refusal order in the domain file: the fixture holds a class, a student with no credential row, and an open old session, and the control case writes (inserts 2, updates 2, audit lines 2). A refused until_17 at 17:00 and a refused unknown value write nothing (insert 0, update 0, delete 0, audit 0). A student session at 23:59 Bangkok answers forbidden or invalid_input and writes nothing.

Tenant scope in the domain file: a class outside the school answers not_found, a teacher of another class answers forbidden, and a student session answers forbidden; each writes nothing with 7 days. The session row holds the school and the class of the authorized classroom. A classroom row of another school makes the tenant-scoped insert throw a TenantScopeError and the session row is not written, so the session insert stays on the tenant-scoped handle.

New handler file apps/primary-advantage/lib/__tests__/student-login-lifetime-handlers.adversarial.test.ts: 44 tests, exit 0. The 27 refused bodies answer 400 with no code field and the domain is not called. A body that carries a prototype key, a broken body, an array body, and a body with no class id answer 400. A body with expiresAt, durationMs, or minutes gives the domain exactly the keys classroomId and lifetime. A body that names the lifetime twice keeps a value inside the choice list. No session answers 401 and a code_only session answers 403 for every choice.

New panel file apps/primary-advantage/components/__tests__/class-session-control.adversarial.test.tsx: 12 tests, exit 0. Each choice posts itself with the two body keys. One radio stays checked in every state. The group shows three options at 16:59:59.999 Bangkok and two at 17:00:00.000 Bangkok. The hidden until_17 choice never reaches the server on a start and on a new code. A double click sends at most two start requests, and every body holds the same lifetime.

The app check-types through heavy-run.sh p2: exit 2 from the one pre-existing untracked foreign file apps/primary-advantage/qa-check-user.tmp.ts (TS2307 at its line 34); the filtered run lists no other error and no error in the new files. Probe for F201 and F202 (a temporary file, removed after the run): two fireEvent clicks on Start send 1 request; two clicks dispatched in one act send 2 requests with the bodies { classroomId, lifetime: '3h' } and { classroomId, lifetime: '3h' }. Without a render after the clock passes 17:00, the start body holds lifetime 'until_17', and the server refuses it.
